line.name: Deadwood Sweet Jane Dia de los Muertos Limited Edition 2024
line.description: DECODE: 'Dia-24' = Dia de los Muertos (Day of the Dead), 2024 release. A limited-edition variant of the Sweet Jane blend (one of Deadwood's 4 core 'Wild Bunch' blends). Originally a Drew Estate Lounge exclusive (2019), returned nationally as a limited edition in 2024, and again in 2025. FLAG: a separate 'Dia De Los Muertos LE Maduro 2025' also exists per at least one retailer - confirm the exact box/year printed on the actual photographed box matches '2024' before treating this as settled, since the two years' releases were not independently distinguished in this pass.
